managedScripts.title: Managed userscripts
managedScripts.description: Userscripts provisioned by enterprise policy. Each item must provide a remote userscript URL or inline userscript source plus an integrity pin or trusted Ed25519 signature.

url.title: Userscript URL
url.description: HTTPS or HTTP userscript URL fetched through ScriptVault's normal install guards.

code.title: Inline userscript source
code.description: Complete userscript source including a ==UserScript== metadata block.

integrity.title: Userscript integrity pin
integrity.description: Required unless signature is supplied. Use sha256-<base64> SRI or sha256:<64-hex>.

signature.title: Trusted userscript signature
signature.description: Optional Ed25519 signature object. The public key must already be trusted in ScriptVault.

managedScriptsCleanup.title: Prune removed managed scripts
managedScriptsCleanup.description: When true, ScriptVault removes locally stored managed scripts that are no longer present in managedScripts.
